title: PlaneMem original Plane retry scheduling receipts
description: Source-only original command, scheduling receipt and recorded/not-observed lookup. Scheduling is not application of the event. Register plane-inbox.json alongside this schema.
$comment: Runtime additionally checks UTF-16/lone surrogate bounds, decimal bigint arithmetic, original normalized command/identity/key binding and record relationships. Existing server verifies immutable stored event/current visibility before saved-receipt lookup. No new runtime/schema-validator integration.

expectedRevision.description: Positive canonical bigint string up to9223372036854775806; numeric versions and leading zeros rejected.

reason.$comment: Raw <=2000 UTF-16 units/no NUL/no lone surrogates then trim. Other control characters are not independently rejected.

key.$comment: Runtime length<=255 UTF-16 units and no lone surrogates. Unicode non-whitespace characters allowed; not restricted to ASCII.

event_id.description: Optional raw body field overwritten by decoded route event_id, without equality/type check.

body.description: Same body for schedule and lookup. request_key required here or Idempotency-Key header; both must agree. No body idempotency_key, identity, expected_version or confirmation field. Version headers forbidden after generic parsing. Actor/client precondition headers independently optional on HTTP; SDK requires both original identities.

command.description: Original normalized command. Request fingerprint=SHA256(stable-key-sorted JSON of {operation:'plane.inbox.retry',identity,command}); key is separate. Replay does not replace original revision or reason.

receipt.description: Original full identity/key/normalized command. record event_id/scope match command/identity, revision=expected_revision+1, attempts=previous_attempts, updated_at=next_attempt_at. Event and attempts are not changed by scheduling. Historical checked_at/status remain unchanged on replay, even after worker applies/rejects/defer. Does not include event payload/fingerprint/original trace or a replayed flag. Current server additionally verifies immutable event fingerprint and monotonic current revision/attempts plus stable aggregate/version/type/received_at before returning saved receipt.

lookup.description: Returned identity/key/command match original request; recorded receipt repeats the same values. not-observed only means no matching scoped original key was observed after current target visibility and immutable-event verification, not command failure or permission to replace the key. Lookup takes transaction/update/advisory locks but does not reschedule or add a scheduling receipt/audit.

retryEnvelope.description: Current trace with original scheduling receipt. HTTP200 means scheduling only; no outer revision/etag/server_cursor, ETag or application proof.
